Stage18G FBStart Deadman Diagnostic
==================================

Base
----
- Exact Stage18F source transformation remains in place.
- Stage18D minimal PowerWell routes remain enabled.
- Stage18E probePortMode Type2 call-site bypass remains enabled.
- st18cEnableFBRoutes remains false; all three broad groups remain guarded.
- Real TGL SKU bypass remains disabled.
- Expected framebuffer/HW state remains 0x9A488086 / 0xFFFF8086.
- Expected boot arguments remain identical to Stage18F; no -ngreenforcefb.

Only new behavior
-----------------
- Route exactly one controller start symbol selected by isprod:
  __ZN31AppleIntelFramebufferController5startEP9IOService
  or
  __ZN24AppleIntelBaseController5startEP9IOService
- The wrapper is pass-through and preserves the original bool return value.
- A thread_call deadman is armed for 30 seconds immediately before callthrough.
- If start returns, st18gFBStartActive is cleared and the later callback is inert.
- If start does not return while kernel scheduling remains alive, the callback
  deliberately panics with the most recently observed phase code and name.
- Phase updates are in-memory volatile stores only; they do not add per-call
  logging or MMIO traffic.

Interpretation
--------------
- Deliberate ST18G DEADMAN panic: start entered and did not return in 30 seconds;
  the phase identifies the last observed routed PowerWell boundary.
- FB_START_RETURN/disarmed: controller start returned; the hard hang is later.
- No deliberate panic after the timeout: the timer thread could not run, so the
  lock likely stops interrupts/scheduling or occurs before the start wrapper.

Safety
------
- USB EFI only.
- Do not change the internal safe EFI, /Library/Extensions, NVRAM, or SMBIOS.
- OpenCore ApplePanic=true, keepsyms=1, debug=0x100, and watchdog=0 are retained.
